messages.content: You answer a question about a short text from what you know. Pick one of the allowed answers. Give the probability, from 0 to 1, that your answer is right.

The text is the title of a song by the Beatles. Who is credited with writing it?

Text: Maggie Mae

Allowed answers:
- John Lennon and Paul McCartney
- George Harrison
- Ringo Starr
- a songwriter outside the Beatles

message.reasoning_content: Maggie Mae on Let It Be, credited to all four Beatles (Lennon/McCartney/Harrison/Starkey). Not an allowed option... closest allowed: "John Lennon and Paul McCartney"? It's credited to all four. Hmm. Credited traditionally "Lennon–McCartney–Harrison–Starkey". Allowed answers don't include that; pick Lennon and Paul with lower probability... Actually best guess among options: John Lennon and Paul McCartney, prob ~0.6?
